purpose: Synthetic continuation, recall and current-gate acceptance scenarios. These are not transcripts. Local tests verify context delivery only; no model behavior has been measured.

cases.name: continue independent backend work after historical UI blockers

content.text: Saved earlier checkpoint: Stage 1 blocked. Scout Docker failed; UI guidance was still required under the earlier plan.
Saved earlier checkpoint: no implementation; waiting for UI research. Next: blocked.

Continue Stage 1 backend/API/storage now. UI research is deferred and is not a prerequisite for this scope. Keep current permission and native cleanup gates. Save the resulting checkpoint and read back that exact saved record. JEV stays off.

expectedBehavior: Treat the two blockers as historical and apply the current backend-only amendment.
Proceed with authorized backend work without requiring UI research or repeating the same permission question.
Keep any genuine current permission, missing backend requirement or uncertain native cleanup gate.
Save actual progress and read the exact saved checkpoint before claiming the requested verification complete.

cases.name: recall only

content.text: Saved checkpoint: backend routes and storage checks passed; UI research remains deferred.
Summarize the saved delivery and its limits only. Do not implement, research, rerun tests or save another checkpoint.

expectedBehavior: Report the historical delivery and remaining limits.
Do not begin implementation, research, tests or duplicate checkpoint writes.

cases.name: current explicit dependency and uncertain execution still stop dependent work

content.text: Earlier note: backend implementation was independently authorized.
For this scope, Stage 1 must wait for UI research and my approval. The previous native operation has uncertain cleanup; do not retry or substitute another runner. You may summarize known facts.

expectedBehavior: Preserve the current explicit research/approval dependency and uncertain cleanup gate.
Do not start or retry dependent implementation; historical authorization does not override this current instruction.
Summarize known facts within the independently authorized scope.

cases.name: settled partial Build continues only remaining scope

content.text: Original Build returned a complete final with settled cleanup. Its retained disposition is unverified: Settings display exists; collector, configuration and lifecycle integration remain. Earlier parent note said launch from the repository; the child was already admitted in that repository.
Finish the remaining authorized telemetry feature. Preserve existing work. Inline implementation is authorized; no model restart, global upgrade or release. JEV stays off.

expectedBehavior: Inspect current files and preserved result, then continue remaining authorized work without replaying the old Build or requesting the same scope again.
Do not turn historical parent routing advice into a new launch prerequisite for an admitted child.
Treat unverified Build delivery as a limitation, not as a Review UNVERIFIED verdict.
Preserve current access, settled execution, required review and explicit no-restart/no-release boundaries.

cases.name: Review UNVERIFIED requires evidence without invented implementation

content.text: Independent Review: Verdict: UNVERIFIED. Next: evidence. The supplied source reference is unavailable; no concrete implementation defect has been established. Cleanup is settled.
Continue resolving the review using supplied local evidence. Do not change implementation just to make an evidence-only result pass.

expectedBehavior: Reconcile the specific unavailable evidence and preserve the existing candidate and review.
Do not infer a product defect, start Build automatically or claim approval without required evidence.

cases.name: optional live evidence and scoped local development setup

content.text: Saved handoff contains verified hardware JSON field names and null semantics. Live generation-speed semantics remain unverified. Local test dependencies are absent.
Implement the optional hardware widget and show unsupported speed as unavailable. Do not start the model, upgrade global packages, or call JEV. Ordinary repository-local development setup is allowed.

expectedBehavior: Reuse supplied hardware evidence and continue independent widget implementation; missing live speed limits that claim only.
Prepare local test dependencies within the allowed scope without broadening permission to global upgrades, model start or JEV.
Do not invent live readings or claim live-load validation occurred.
